effect_summary: Secondary keywords on all equipped cards gain +1 potency. At boss start, gain Prophecy for 6s.
Each new buff type this wave grants +2 SPD and +1 PWR (max 5).
Gain bonus ATK/DEF/SPD/PWR equal to 25% of your highest non-HP derived stat, distributed to the other three.
Start each wave with Plating 12. First fatal hit each run leaves you at 1 HP and grants Regen 5 for 6s.
Enemy special skills charge 20% slower. Foresight reveals specials 2s earlier.
First hit on each enemy applies Whiteout: Vulnerable 2 and -20% SPD for 4s.
On elite kill, steal its highest stat bonus until end of run. Boss thresholds at 70/40/10% HP grant +2 all non-HP stats.
Tactical item becomes passive at 35% power if it is a buff or map. Burst tacticals auto-trigger at wave start and boss start.
50% of overheal from Lifesteal/Regen is dealt as corruption damage to current target.
+35 max HP. Overhealing converts to Strength (1 per 10 overheal, max 8 per wave).
First time each wave you would take fatal damage, prevent it and gain Veil: self-Burn deals 50% less for 6s.
Start each wave with Plating 10. Enemy specials cannot deal more than 25% of your max HP.
At wave start, lose 10% max HP; attacks gain Burn equal to lost HP / 10 for the wave.
First incoming hit each wave is always dodged. Successful dodge grants +1 PWR.
Every 4th direct hit is an Execution hit for +60% damage. If target is below 35% HP, repeat it at 50% power.
Once per run on reaching 0 HP, set HP to 25%, gain +10 SPD and +5 Strength for 8s.
First kill each wave detonates remaining enemies for Burn 3 and Poison 3.
Gain Charge at wave start. Every 3 actions, consume Charge to strike all enemies for 60% ATK; kills refresh Charge.
When an enemy debuffs you, reflect 1 stack of its last non-unique debuff and gain Block 4.
mechanical_notes: Counter-debuff mask; exact reflected stack order discovered in logs.

effect_summary: Every third buff gained refreshes all your buff durations and grants Plating 2.
Whenever you act before the current target, gain Strength 1 (max 8 per wave).
Every third harmful effect applied to you also applies Corruption to the enemy: Burn 2 + Poison 2.
mechanical_notes: Corruption counterplay; hidden proc cadence unlocks in codex after 3 triggers.

effect_summary: Once per wave at 30% HP or less, immediately fill action meter to 100 and gain Dodge 20% for 2s.
Every 3 direct hits, your next hit gains +50% direct damage and Stagger 1.
While above 70% HP, gain Regen 2 and +4 PWR. While below 40%, gain Block 6 on action.
Copy 35% of the higher of ATK or DEF into the lower. Repeat once when entering boss wave.
Your secondary keyword on all equipped cards counts as active at 50% value.
mechanical_notes: Hybrid enabler; true value emerges in loadout analyzer and logs.

effect_summary: The first trigger from each equipped non-Tactical card each wave repeats at 50% power.
Reveal the boss special pattern at wave start. After each reveal, your next hit deals +15% and gains +1 of its primary keyword.
On enemy death, spread half its Burn and Poison to all other enemies.
If Charm B is not a Ring, gain +20% ATK and +10 max HP. If paired with Mark of the Shaper, unlock Elder/Shaper Union.
If Charm B is not a Ring, Focus triggers deal +25% more. If paired with Mark of the Elder, every 4th hit echoes a Focus bolt.
At wave start, roll Fortune: Greed (+25% ATK, -10 DEF), Shelter (+20 HP, -10 SPD), or Grace (+15 SPD, -10 ATK).
mechanical_notes: Odds are hidden in logs and codex; score bonus if boss dies with this equipped.

effect_summary: Every 3rd mainhand hit immediately triggers your offhand effect or Focus passive at 50% power.
Heavy hits gain Overwhelm 35% (ignore 35% DEF). On kill, gain Strength 2.
Each attack randomly empowers itself with one extra package: Burn 3, Poison 3, or Vulnerable 2.
At boss start, your highest-value Charm keyword gains +2 for 8s.
Whenever you gain Block or Dodge, gain Strength 1.
On kill, splash 30% of the hit to adjacent enemies.
Whenever you heal above 80% HP, gain Plating 1.
When Burn kills an enemy, explode remaining enemies for Burn 2.
Each successful dodge grants +2 SPD for the wave (max 10).
Gain +1 PWR each time you hit while above 25 SPD (max 6); at 6, next hit gains Lifesteal +6%.
Direct hits apply Burn 2 if target is already Vulnerable.
Your first two hits each wave gain +20% direct damage.
Below 50% HP, gain Dodge 10% and Strength 2.
After 3 seconds without being hit, gain +15 action meter instantly.
Burning targets also become Vulnerable 1.
+25% ATK, but you take +15% direct damage.
At wave start, gain one random minor synergy for that wave.
mechanical_notes: Actual rolled synergy only visible in combat log until codex unlock.

effect_summary: Your first support or tactical trigger each wave is immediate and costs no setup time.
Whenever the enemy telegraphs a special, gain +4 PWR for 4s.
Every 3rd rapier hit fires a free spell bolt for 50% ATK and Burn 1.
Deal +25% direct damage to targets suffering two or more different ailments/debuffs.
Poison from your hits also gains Overwhelm 20% (ignores 20% DEF).
